description.value: Royal Lodge Motel is a clean, affordable motel in Hope, BC, positioned at the convergence of Highways 1, 3, 5, and 7 — making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists on any of the major interior routes. The property offers king, queen, double, and triple rooms with in-room fridges and microwaves. Hope's trailhead access and highway crossroads position make this a practical base for touring cyclists passing between the coast and the BC interior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and actively soliciting bookings ('Registrations open, contact us and book your room!'), confirming the motel is open. The website confirms the OSM phone number (+1 604-869-5358) and email, and describes room types with amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi across all room types. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (+1 778-868-1002) not present in OSM tags.

Several staff profile bios and a contact page section contain 'Lorem ipsum' placeholder text, suggesting the website is partially under construction — however, core business information (name, location, phone, email, room types) appears legitimate and consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel at a major cycling crossroads in Hope, BC. Actively taking reservations.

wow_evidence: positioned at the convergence of Highways 1, 3, 5, and 7
